title: Reduce a genuinely coupled arbitrary-rank creation family to one scalar factorial law
statement: Partition species into fixed s>=2 nonempty groups and include EVERY reversible0<->sum_g X_(g,i_g) tuple reaction. Stoichiometric rank is d-s+1. Actual class is the ENTIRE nonnegative fibre N_g-N_1=h_g: deaths lower common totals, and a birth/death exchanges any identity within a group, including minimal boundary compositions. Let S_g=sum lambda_(g,i),p_(g,i)=lambda_(g,i)/S_g,q=product S_g,n=N_1,nmin=max(0,max_g -h_g). Multinomial summation gives Z=(product S_g^h_g)*sum_(n>=nmin)q^n/product_g(n+h_g)!, and given n each group is an independent multinomial of total n+h_g. Consequently E X_(g,i)=p_(g,i)*(f(q)+h_g). This is a COUPLED non-product law with arbitrarily high fixed rank; the hub0<->A+B_i is its s=2 special case. No arbitrary reaction-class=fibre identification is imported.
